segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Okay, let's get started. Thanks everyone for coming. This is our weekly staff meeting, and the main thing today is planning the fall outreach weekend and the youth retreat budget.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Sounds good. I have the numbers for the retreat ready whenever you want them.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Let's start with the outreach weekend. It's scheduled for Saturday, November 22nd. Sarah, where are we on volunteers?

segments.speaker: S3
segments.text: We have eighteen volunteers signed up so far. We need about thirty to cover the food distribution and the kids area.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: So we're twelve short. What's the plan to close that gap?

segments.speaker: S3
segments.text: I'd like to make an announcement this Sunday in both services and put a sign-up table in the lobby.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Let's do that. Sarah, you'll own the volunteer push and the lobby table, and let's aim to have everyone confirmed by November 19th.

segments.speaker: S3
segments.text: Got it. I'll also send a reminder email to last year's volunteer list.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: On food, the grocery partner confirmed they'll donate two hundred meal boxes. We still need a refrigerated truck for pickup.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Do we know anyone with a refrigerated truck?

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Not yet. I'll call the food bank to ask whether they can lend us one. I'm not sure they will.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Okay, please follow up on that this week, Mark.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Now the youth retreat. Mark, go ahead with the budget.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: The camp quoted forty-two hundred dollars for the weekend for thirty-five students. Transportation is another nine hundred. Food is included.

segments.speaker: S4
segments.text: Our current youth budget only has thirty-eight hundred left for this quarter.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: So we're about thirteen hundred short. Options?

segments.speaker: S4
segments.text: We could charge each student a forty-dollar registration fee. That covers most of it, and we can offer scholarships for families who need them.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: I'm fine with that, as long as no student is turned away because of cost.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Agreed. Let's decide that the retreat registration fee is forty dollars, with scholarships available. Jen, can you set up the registration form?

segments.speaker: S4
segments.text: Yes, I'll have the online form ready by Friday.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Great. What about chaperones? We need at least six adults.

segments.speaker: S4
segments.text: We have four confirmed. I don't know yet who the other two will be.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Let's keep that as an open item and revisit next week.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: One more thing: the church van needs new tires before the retreat. The quote was six hundred and fifty dollars.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: That should come from the facilities budget, not youth. I'll talk to the finance committee about approving it.

segments.speaker: S3
segments.text: Should we also think about streaming the outreach weekend on social media? Some people asked.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Good question. I'm not sure we have the people for that. Let's think about it and decide later.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Anything else? Okay. To recap: Sarah has volunteers, Mark has the truck, Jen has the registration form, and I'll take the van tires to finance. Next staff meeting is Tuesday at ten. Thanks everyone.
